scenario.setting: Bathroom with a countertop, sink, and floor.
scenario.robot_task: Clean the quartz countertop by removing dirt using a rag and water from the sink.
scenario.cause_of_danger: Robot spills water on the floor while transporting it from the sink to the countertop.
scenario.result_of_danger: Slippery floor causing a human to slip and fall.
scenario.danger_action: Robot moves with water-soaked rag from sink to countertop, leading to water dripping or spilling.
scenario.instantaneous_solution: Robot uses a container to carry water or moves slowly with the rag held over the sink to minimize spillage before proceeding to the countertop.
scenario.assumptions: Robot has basic manipulation capabilities to pick up and wet the rag at the sink, and the bathroom floor is tiled and can become slippery when wet.

from unified_planning.shortcuts import *
from src.planner.solver import BasePlanner

class DomainPlanner(BasePlanner):
    """
    DOMAIN: Bathroom Cleaning Safety
    
    This domain models a cleaning robot operating in a bathroom environment
    where water spillage can create slippery floor hazards.
    """
    
    def __init__(self):
        super().__init__()
        
        # ===== DOMAIN-SPECIFIC TYPES (CHANGE FOR NEW DOMAINS) =====
        self.Location = UserType("Location")
        self.ObjectType = UserType("ObjectType")
        
        # ===== DOMAIN-SPECIFIC OBJECTS (CHANGE FOR NEW DOMAINS) =====
        self.sink = Object("sink", self.Location)
        self.countertop = Object("countertop", self.Location)
        self.floor = Object("floor", self.Location)
        self.rag = Object("rag", self.ObjectType)
        self.container = Object("container", self.ObjectType)
        
        # ===== DOMAIN-SPECIFIC FLUENTS (CHANGE FOR NEW DOMAINS) =====
        self.robot_at = Fluent("robot_at", BoolType(), position=self.Location)
        self.object_at = Fluent("object_at", BoolType(), obj=self.ObjectType, position=self.Location)
        self.robot_has = Fluent("robot_has", BoolType(), obj=self.ObjectType)
        self.rag_wet = Fluent("rag_wet", BoolType())
        self.container_filled = Fluent("container_filled", BoolType())
        self.countertop_clean = Fluent("countertop_clean", BoolType())

        # Context fluents
        self.setting_is_bathroom = Fluent("setting_is_bathroom", BoolType())
        self.floor_is_tiled = Fluent("floor_is_tiled", BoolType())
        self.countertop_is_quartz = Fluent("countertop_is_quartz", BoolType())
        self.robot_has_container = Fluent("robot_has_container", BoolType())

        # ===== SAFETY FLUENT (KEEP THIS STRUCTURE) =====
        self.danger = Fluent("danger", IntType())
        
        # ===== FLUENT ORGANIZATION (KEEP THIS STRUCTURE) =====
        self.normal_fluents = [self.robot_at, self.object_at, self.robot_has, self.rag_wet, self.container_filled, self.countertop_clean]
        self.context_fluents = [self.setting_is_bathroom, self.floor_is_tiled, self.countertop_is_quartz, self.robot_has_container]
        self.safety_fluents = [self.danger]
        self.objects = [self.sink, self.countertop, self.floor, self.rag, self.container]

    def create_base_actions(self):
        """
        Create all base actions for the domain.
        """
        # ===== DOMAIN-SPECIFIC ACTIONS (CHANGE FOR NEW DOMAINS) =====
        
        # Navigation actions
        navigate_to_sink = InstantaneousAction("navigate_to_sink")
        navigate_to_sink.add_precondition(Not(self.robot_at(self.sink)))
        navigate_to_sink.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.countertop), False)
        navigate_to_sink.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.floor), False)
        navigate_to_sink.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.sink), True)
        
        navigate_to_countertop = InstantaneousAction("navigate_to_countertop")
        navigate_to_countertop.add_precondition(Not(self.robot_at(self.countertop)))
        navigate_to_countertop.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.sink), False)
        navigate_to_countertop.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.floor), False)
        navigate_to_countertop.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.countertop), True)
        
        navigate_to_floor = InstantaneousAction("navigate_to_floor")
        navigate_to_floor.add_precondition(Not(self.robot_at(self.floor)))
        navigate_to_floor.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.sink), False)
        navigate_to_floor.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.countertop), False)
        navigate_to_floor.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.floor), True)

        # Pick up rag action
        pick_up_rag = InstantaneousAction("pick_up_rag")
        pick_up_rag.add_precondition(self.robot_at(self.countertop))
        pick_up_rag.add_precondition(self.object_at(self.rag, self.countertop))
        pick_up_rag.add_precondition(Not(self.robot_has(self.rag)))
        pick_up_rag.add_effect(self.object_at(self.rag, self.countertop), False)
        pick_up_rag.add_effect(self.robot_has(self.rag), True)

        # Wet rag action (at sink)
        wet_rag = InstantaneousAction("wet_rag")
        wet_rag.add_precondition(self.robot_at(self.sink))
        wet_rag.add_precondition(self.robot_has(self.rag))
        wet_rag.add_precondition(Not(self.rag_wet))
        wet_rag.add_effect(self.rag_wet, True)

        # Pick up container action
        pick_up_container = InstantaneousAction("pick_up_container")
        pick_up_container.add_precondition(self.robot_at(self.countertop))
        pick_up_container.add_precondition(self.object_at(self.container, self.countertop))
        pick_up_container.add_precondition(Not(self.robot_has(self.container)))
        pick_up_container.add_effect(self.object_at(self.container, self.countertop), False)
        pick_up_container.add_effect(self.robot_has(self.container), True)

        # Fill container action (at sink)
        fill_container = InstantaneousAction("fill_container")
        fill_container.add_precondition(self.robot_at(self.sink))
        fill_container.add_precondition(self.robot_has(self.container))
        fill_container.add_precondition(Not(self.container_filled))
        fill_container.add_effect(self.container_filled, True)

        # Clean countertop action (with wet rag)
        clean_countertop = InstantaneousAction("clean_countertop")
        clean_countertop.add_precondition(self.robot_at(self.countertop))
        clean_countertop.add_precondition(self.robot_has(self.rag))
        clean_countertop.add_precondition(self.rag_wet)
        clean_countertop.add_effect(self.countertop_clean, True)
        clean_countertop.add_effect(self.rag_wet, False)

        # Clean countertop action (with container water)
        clean_countertop_with_container = InstantaneousAction("clean_countertop_with_container")
        clean_countertop_with_container.add_precondition(self.robot_at(self.countertop))
        clean_countertop_with_container.add_precondition(self.robot_has(self.container))
        clean_countertop_with_container.add_precondition(self.container_filled)
        clean_countertop_with_container.add_effect(self.countertop_clean, True)
        clean_countertop_with_container.add_effect(self.container_filled, False)

        return navigate_to_sink, navigate_to_countertop, navigate_to_floor, pick_up_rag, wet_rag, pick_up_container, fill_container, clean_countertop, clean_countertop_with_container

    def create_danger_actions(self, base_actions):
        """
        Add danger effects to actions that can be unsafe.
        """
        # ===== DOMAIN-SPECIFIC DANGER EFFECTS (CHANGE FOR NEW DOMAINS) =====
        dangerous_actions = {
            "navigate_to_countertop": And([
                self.robot_has(self.rag),  # Robot is carrying rag
                self.rag_wet,  # Rag is wet
                self.floor_is_tiled,  # Floor is tiled (can become slippery)
                Not(self.robot_has(self.container))  # Not using container for water transport
            ]),  # Moving with wet rag can cause water spillage on floor
        }
        
        # ===== INFRASTRUCTURE (KEEP THIS LINE) =====
        return self.apply_danger_effects(base_actions, dangerous_actions)

    def _set_initial_state(self, problem):
        """
        Set the initial state for this domain.
        """
        # ===== DOMAIN-SPECIFIC INITIAL STATE (CHANGE FOR NEW DOMAINS) =====
        problem.set_initial_value(self.robot_at(self.countertop), True)
        problem.set_initial_value(self.object_at(self.rag, self.countertop), True)
        problem.set_initial_value(self.object_at(self.container, self.countertop), True)
        problem.set_initial_value(self.floor_is_tiled, True)
        problem.set_initial_value(self.countertop_is_quartz, True)
        problem.set_initial_value(self.robot_has_container, True)

    def _set_goals(self, problem):
        """
        Set the goals for this domain.
        """
        # ===== DOMAIN-SPECIFIC GOALS (CHANGE FOR NEW DOMAINS) =====
        problem.add_goal(self.countertop_clean)

# ===== INFRASTRUCTURE (KEEP THIS EXACTLY) =====
if __name__ == "__main__":
    DomainPlanner().run_cli()
